label: Intervalsync
description: W′ balance and best-power data fields, an end-of-ride summary, and your Intervalsync account on the Karoo: training context, coach and team spaces, planned workouts, and today's brief and power and heart rate caps with in-ride alerts. Connecting needs an account at intervalsync.icu.
releaseNotes: Today's brief from your coach or assistant at the top of the Training tab. Last ride summary falls back to your newest ride from Intervals.icu. Past rides: the effort's main zone, a Coach comment tab, and badges for new 90-day bests.
